The underlying conversion factor is stated earlier: “We adopted the metallicity-dependent conversion factor from Amorín et al. (2016) ... which yields αCO ≈69” (Sect. 3.3). The SSC upper-limit paragraph also explicitly notes the CO-dark caveat: “This suggests that a substantial fraction of the molecular gas in the immediate vicinity of the SSC could be CO-dark,” and Sect. 4.1 adds that “the detected CO emission likely represents only a fraction of the total molecular gas.”

In Section 4.3, the paper converts the CO(1-0) flux upper limit at the SSC into 'an upper limit in molecular mass of 4.1× 10^6 M⊙' without specifying the assumed αCO in that context, and applies a standard conversion to bound the mass despite immediately arguing the region is dominated by CO-dark gas.
